title: ChaosPlugin
description: A plugin that unleashes chaos upon your Minecraft world through events chosen randomly. Warning: It may cause a lot of damage to your worlds.
body:
# Overview
The ChaosPlugin is a simple plugin that launches different events that affect your world. They happen every 15 seconds by default, but the frequency can be modified through the `/chaostimer` command. To begin launching events automatically, you can use the `/chaoslaunch` command and `/chaosstop` to stop.

Currently, there is a total of 27 chaos events. Some are rarer than others. In total, there are:
- 6 beneficial events.
- 6 neutral events.
- 12 negative events.
- 3 special events.

This plugin was created for a "plugin jam" with friends, and therefore was done in only a few hours and may not be polished. I decided to upload it as someone could still maybe have some fun with it.

There will be little to no maintenance.

**Warning: events will cause massive damage to your worlds. Proceed with caution.**

# Permissions
- chaosplugin.launch: Allows you to use the `/chaoslaunch` command to begin automatic execution of events.
- chaosplugin.stop: Allows you to use the `/chaosstop` command to stop automatic execution of events.
- chaosplugin.timer: Allows you to use the `/chaostimer` command to change the frequency of automatic execution of events.
